name: boundary-max-ciphertext
notes: The maximum-legal envelope (§3.1): decoded ciphertext INCLUDING the 16-byte GCM tag is exactly 1,048,576 bytes, and the unpadded base64url wire spelling is 1,398,102 characters -- longer than the cap. A conforming receiver measures the decoded bytes and ACCEPTS this; a receiver that measures encoded characters or total wire JSON rejects it, which is the regression this vector exists to catch. Own type per §10.1: consume it in a dedicated receiver context, never interleaved with the packed envelope suite.
